scores.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`, and wrong TypeScript interface names). Furthermore, it completely omitted the required `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in configuration, leaving the feature unconditionally enabled. It also directly violated the explicit requirement and acceptance criterion to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error when `listFor` is missing on the store, returning an empty array (`sessions: []`) instead. Validation also missed the `1-200` bounds check on `limit` (allowing `0`), and required documentation updates in `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md` were skipped. On the positive side, the candidate did wire `createMessageHandler` off the per-session lock, validated the composite `before` cursor, and ignored client-supplied `userId`.
